name: PIOPPINO
blurb: FAST AND WARM-LOVING IN THE FRUIT ROOM.

overview.v: Fast, warm-loving, tough. Ideal conditions are very different from oyster.
Needs a steady metabolic rate; shows up any variable that is off.
Changing grain supplier can change fruit body form dramatically: "rule number one".
AACN house code, possibly not true A. aegerita.

cultivation.v: 3-4 weeks; ready when yellow or orange droplets appear.

timeline.v: About 3 weeks for patchy colonies to join. Shipped at about 3 weeks.
Fluff, then amber droplets, then a carpet of pins.

climate.v: Same room as chestnut, about 19 °C. Little heat given off.
18-24 °C ideal, tolerates 27-29 °C. Warmer is faster. The 16 °C room is below range.
climate.n: BELOW RANGE FOR FARM FRUIT ROOM

climate.v: Lights on once the pin carpet forms.

hazards.v: First of the common species to show it; attracts far more green mould than maitake.
Flat glossy slick top that never pins. No fluff is a warning sign.

notes.v: Mix its rows with oyster or chestnut in incubation so heat evens out.
